messages:
marta: opened a PR to refresh the model card for comet-6b-q4 — clarifies supported builds, adds a compact bench table, and a short "migration notes" block. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5042

lee: thanks — can you include both py/js streaming examples? folks still use stream=true.

ana: small correction: the current card lists 16k context for q4 but effective is closer to ~15k on quantized builds. add "effective context" note.

marta: good catch. PR now has: - limits row with effective context for q4 - bench table with hardware column (A100-40GB, A10G, CPU-int8) - py/js snippet using response_mode: 'stream'

lee: sample JS snippet looks fine. propose one-line CLI migration note too: `redwood infer --response-mode stream` (replaces --stream).

ci-bot: build/docs: #5042 — linkcheck failed on /model-catalog/comet-6b-q4.html#migration-notes (404)

marta: fixed anchor and pushed. added commit sha in bench table for reproducibility.

ci-bot: build/docs: #5042 — linkcheck passed

ana: LGTM, leaving two tiny wording nits on the effective-context sentence.

lee: approved, merging after nits. good template for other model cards.
